# Carer Support Portal (fictional demonstration)
Department of Community Services demo. All policy, amounts and citizens are invented. Run scenarios with `make scenario NAME=...`, see `docs/runbook.md`.

1.title: Claims submitted
1.query:
fetch bizevents
| filter event.provider == "dcs.carer-portal"
| filter event.type == "claim.submitted"
| summarize submitted = count()

2.title: Payments posted
2.query:
fetch bizevents
| filter event.provider == "dcs.carer-portal"
| filter event.type == "claim.payment_posted"
| summarize posted = count()

3.title: Payments failed
3.query:
fetch bizevents
| filter event.provider == "dcs.carer-portal"
| filter event.type == "claim.payment_failed"
| summarize failed = count()

4.title: Average queue wait (ms)
4.query:
fetch bizevents
| filter event.provider == "dcs.carer-portal"
| filter event.type == "claim.payment_posted"
| summarize wait = avg(queue_wait_ms)

5.title: Tokens used
5.query:
timeseries tokens = sum(gen_ai.client.token.usage)
| fieldsAdd total = arraySum(tokens)
| fields total

6.title: Prompts blocked by guardrails
6.query:
fetch spans
| filter service.name == "claims-api" and startsWith(toString(span.name), "chat ")
| summarize blocked = countIf(matchesPhrase(toString(gen_ai.response.finish_reasons), "content_filter"))

8.title: Claim journey, events by step
8.query:
fetch bizevents
| filter event.provider == "dcs.carer-portal"
| summarize events = count(), by: {event.type}
| sort events desc

9.title: Claims over time
9.query:
fetch bizevents
| filter event.provider == "dcs.carer-portal"
| filter in(event.type, "claim.submitted", "claim.payment_posted", "claim.payment_failed")
| makeTimeseries events = count(), by: {event.type}

10.title: Payment queue wait (ms)
10.query:
fetch bizevents
| filter event.provider == "dcs.carer-portal"
| filter event.type == "claim.payment_posted"
| makeTimeseries average = avg(queue_wait_ms), p95 = percentile(queue_wait_ms, 95)

11.title: Failed payments by error
11.query:
fetch bizevents
| filter event.provider == "dcs.carer-portal"
| filter event.type == "claim.payment_failed"
| summarize failed = count(), by: {error}

12.title: Server response time p95 by service

15.title: Chat completion latency
15.query:
fetch spans
| filter service.name == "claims-api" and startsWith(toString(span.name), "chat ")
| makeTimeseries p50 = percentile(duration, 50), p95 = percentile(duration, 95)

16.title: Guardrail outcome per chat
16.query:
fetch spans
| filter service.name == "claims-api" and startsWith(toString(span.name), "chat ")
| fieldsAdd outcome = if(matchesPhrase(toString(gen_ai.response.finish_reasons), "content_filter"), "blocked", else: "allowed")
| summarize chats = count(), by: {outcome}

17.title: Chat errors by type
17.query:
fetch spans
| filter service.name == "claims-api" and startsWith(toString(span.name), "chat ")
| filter isNotNull(error.type)
| summarize failed = count(), by: {error.type}

19.title: Largest contentful paint, p75
19.query:
fetch user.events
| filter dt.rum.application.entity == "APPLICATION-EA7C4B59F27D43EB"
| filter isNotNull(web_vitals.largest_contentful_paint)
| summarize value = percentile(web_vitals.largest_contentful_paint, 75)

20.title: Interaction to next paint, p75
20.query:
fetch user.events
| filter dt.rum.application.entity == "APPLICATION-EA7C4B59F27D43EB"
| filter isNotNull(web_vitals.interaction_to_next_paint)
| summarize value = percentile(web_vitals.interaction_to_next_paint, 75)

21.title: Cumulative layout shift, p75
21.query:
fetch user.events
| filter dt.rum.application.entity == "APPLICATION-EA7C4B59F27D43EB"
| filter isNotNull(web_vitals.cumulative_layout_shift)
| summarize value = percentile(web_vitals.cumulative_layout_shift, 75)

22.title: Time to first byte, p75
22.query:
fetch user.events
| filter dt.rum.application.entity == "APPLICATION-EA7C4B59F27D43EB"
| filter isNotNull(web_vitals.time_to_first_byte)
| summarize value = percentile(web_vitals.time_to_first_byte, 75)

23.title: Journey completion rate
23.query:
fetch user.events
| filter dt.rum.application.entity == "APPLICATION-EA7C4B59F27D43EB"
| filter characteristics.has_view_summary == true
| summarize logins = countIf(view.detected_name == "/login"), statuses = countIf(view.detected_name == "/status"), by: {dt.rum.session.id}
| filter logins > 0
| summarize sessions = count(), completed = countIf(statuses > 0)
| fieldsAdd completion = completed * 100.0 / sessions
| fields completion

24.title: Journey abandonment rate
24.query:
fetch user.events
| filter dt.rum.application.entity == "APPLICATION-EA7C4B59F27D43EB"
| filter characteristics.has_view_summary == true
| summarize logins = countIf(view.detected_name == "/login"), statuses = countIf(view.detected_name == "/status"), by: {dt.rum.session.id}
| filter logins > 0
| summarize sessions = count(), completed = countIf(statuses > 0)
| fieldsAdd abandonment = (sessions - completed) * 100.0 / sessions
| fields abandonment

25.title: RUM funnel, sessions per step
25.query:
fetch user.events
| filter dt.rum.application.entity == "APPLICATION-EA7C4B59F27D43EB"
| filter characteristics.has_view_summary == true
| summarize sessions = countDistinct(dt.rum.session.id), by: {view.detected_name}
| sort sessions desc

26.title: Furthest step reached per session
26.query:
fetch user.events
| filter dt.rum.application.entity == "APPLICATION-EA7C4B59F27D43EB"
| filter characteristics.has_view_summary == true
| fieldsAdd step = if(view.detected_name == "/login", 1, else: if(view.detected_name == "/payment-type", 2, else: if(view.detected_name == "/details", 3, else: if(view.detected_name == "/eligibility", 4, else: if(view.detected_name == "/upload", 5, else: if(view.detected_name == "/review", 6, else: if(view.detected_name == "/status", 7, else: 0)))))))
| summarize furthest = max(step), by: {dt.rum.session.id}
| filter furthest > 0
| fieldsAdd reached = if(furthest == 1, "1 login", else: if(furthest == 2, "2 payment-type", else: if(furthest == 3, "3 details", else: if(furthest == 4, "4 eligibility", else: if(furthest == 5, "5 upload", else: if(furthest == 6, "6 review", else: if(furthest == 7, "7 status", else: "other")))))))
| summarize sessions = count(), by: {reached}
| sort reached asc

27.title: Web vitals over time, p75
27.query:
fetch user.events
| filter dt.rum.application.entity == "APPLICATION-EA7C4B59F27D43EB"
| makeTimeseries lcp = percentile(web_vitals.largest_contentful_paint, 75), fcp = percentile(web_vitals.first_contentful_paint, 75), ttfb = percentile(web_vitals.time_to_first_byte, 75)

28.title: Browser errors over time
28.query:
fetch user.events
| filter dt.rum.application.entity == "APPLICATION-EA7C4B59F27D43EB"
| makeTimeseries javascript = sum(error.exception_count), http_4xx = sum(error.http_4xx_count), http_5xx = sum(error.http_5xx_count)

30.title: Deployment events
30.query:
fetch events
| filter event.type == "CUSTOM_DEPLOYMENT"
| fields timestamp, event.name, event.description
| sort timestamp desc
| limit 10

31.title: Problems on the demo services
31.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter contains(toString(affected_entity_ids), "SERVICE-A07B249CEC01B91E") or contains(toString(affected_entity_ids), "SERVICE-F5D773513E6C7E59") or contains(toString(affected_entity_ids), "SERVICE-B5B342815508E1EE") or contains(toString(affected_entity_ids), "SERVICE-197A36756FADC0DA") or contains(toString(affected_entity_ids), "SERVICE-4896FBFBEE918D79")
| fields timestamp, display_id, event.name, event.status
| sort timestamp desc
| limit 10
